g.text: DESIGN THAT CARES // DIETER RAMS PRINCIPLES
HONEST MATERIALS • PAPER SCREEN • AMBER DIAL • MINIMAL DESIGN
Good design doesn't try to fool anyone.
It is calm, useful, and friendly to hold.
Every letter has space to breathe so
words never look crowded or blurry.
“He drew with kind ink to help everyone think, and soothe tired eyes from their woes!”
Made with care for schools, families, and clinics. 100% free under SIL Open Font License.
